tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Dew. Page background on every screen: a whisper of green, never stark white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and inputs sitting on bg.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Mint. Soft panels, selected chips, 'fits my plan' highlights, illustration grounds. Text on it uses ink or brand.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and units (kcal, g). Passes AA on bg, surface and tint.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Forest. The bicep leaf, primary buttons, links, the active tab, progress bars and focus rings. Text on a brand fill uses on-brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Sprout. The forearm leaf, illustrations, success ticks beside a label, decorative fills. 2.6:1 on light bg: never text there and never the only cue for state; meaningful UI graphics use brand. Text on an accent fill uses on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Clay. Errors, allergy warnings and destructive actions. A state colour, not a brand colour.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero lines on the website and onboarding, in brand. One per screen.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Wide-spaced uppercase label above titles and under the logo (Latin only; Arabic uses the label style). Colour ink-muted or brand.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and section headings, recipe names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Swap white rice for freekeh and keep the same calories with more fibre.
styles.usage: Default reading text in Arabic and English.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, tabs and form labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Estimated from the chain's published menu
styles.usage: Hints, data sources and legal lines. Colour ink-muted.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Calories and macros, with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) so columns line up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap and tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, and between cards and form groups.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons (full pill, like 'Get started'), avatars and toggles.
